Setting up the Claude LTI in Canvas is a great way to integrate these tools for your students. To get started, you will need to sign in as an administrator in Canvas to create the developer key. If you do not have administrator permissions, you may need to coordinate these steps with your institution's IT department.

1. Navigate to Admin and then Developer Keys in Canvas.
2. Click + Developer Key followed by + LTI Key.
3. Enter "Claude LTI" as the Key Name and Title, then provide a short description for the app.
4. Set the Redirect URIs and the Target Link URI to https://claude.ai/lti/launch.
5. Set the OpenID Connect Initiation Url to https://claude.ai/api/lti/login and the JWK method to https://claude.ai/api/lti/keys.
6. Under Additional Settings, toggle the Privacy Level to Public.
7. Under Placements, it is recommended to remove the defaults and add Course Navigation and Assignment Edit as the options.
8. Click Save and then toggle the state to On.

If you encounter any issues while configuring these settings in your Canvas environment, please contact support directly for further assistance.
